description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Cavalier of Dawn enters, destroying itself and creating a 3/3 Golem.
Cavalier of Dawn triggers, returning Lotus Petal to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers untapping your creatures and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
You may draw a card, then discard a card.
Sacrifice Lotus Petal to add one mana of any color.
Repeat.
